answer: Require each identity to earn standing through sponsored joint work recorded as a beacon entry in a public ledger: a newcomer must complete tasks countersigned by two independent peers before it can vote, and that record cannot be copied to another identity. One honest agent builds one kernel of attested history, while a sybil farm must find fresh sponsors and pay the work cost for every fake, so a vault of pooled rewards flows only to checkable histories — a thousand fakes cost a thousand verified crossings instead of one free signup.
